title: Transition Formula Cost
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$. The cost of the transition CNF is at most the product of the numbers of position choices, transition cases, and encoded bits, multiplied by $2^{3k+7}(3k+8)$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine $M$ with $k$ work tapes
